title: Dark Angels
subtitle: Wrath of the Rock + Assault Brethren · 2000/2000 pts · Take and Hold

sequence.name: Pre-game
items: 1. Muster armies: Force Disposition = Take and Hold. Lion El'Jonson must be your Warlord
2. Determine mission (from both players' dispositions)
3. Determine deployment map
4. (Optional) Twist
5. Create the battlefield
6. Deploy and finish pre-game, in your mission pack's order:
↳ Decide reserves: Lion (Deep Strike); Belial + Knights (Deep Strike, or Strategic Reserves to use the Teleport Homer)
↳ Embark: Rhinos carry up to 12 non-Terminator infantry each (see Rhino card)
↳ Before the battle: place Belial's Teleport Homer token

sequence.name: Each turn
items: Start of battle round: +1 CP (Lion's Transhuman Strategist)
1. Start of turn step
2. Command: +1 CP each → pick combat doctrine; Lion picks 2 Primarch abilities + Master Strategist → Battle-shock step
3. Movement: Azrael names a unit + doctrine; Techmarine blesses a vehicle → then reinforcements
4. Shooting (cover = -1 BS; Bolter Discipline near objectives)
5. Charge (chargers get Fights First until end of turn)
6. Fight: Fights First (Lion always), then the rest, alternating
7. End of turn: non-mission rules, then mission scoring

sequence.name: Planning rules
items: One stratagem per unit per phase
Each doctrine once per battle (Assault twice): only 4 doctrine picks in total
A unit has only one doctrine at a time, except the Lion (Master Strategist adds one on top)
Deep Strike: >8" from enemies. Rapid Ingress: not in battle round 1
Ingress: wholly within 6" of an edge, >8" from enemies; not in enemy deployment zone before round 3

plan.summary: Hold the middle with tough, hard-to-wound infantry, kill the enemy units that contest it with the Lion and Deathwing, and time your four doctrine picks for the turns you charge.

sections.name: Deployment
items: Intercessors (OC 10 each) on home objectives: Bolter Discipline gives them +1 to hit while an objective is in range anyway.
Gladiator Lancer and Ballistus on long firing lanes; Techmarine within 3" of one of them (Lone Operative there, and the Blessing next Movement).
Rhino A: Azrael + Companions (7). Rhino B: Hellblasters + Ezekiel (6), or an Intercessor squad. Rhinos can't carry the Knights (Terminators).
Lion: deploy within 3" of a Dark Angels infantry unit for Lone Operative, or keep him in Deep Strike.
Belial's Teleport Homer goes in midfield cover where enemies won't walk within 1" of it.

sections.name: Scoring
items: Biggest OC: Azrael's unit 13, Intercessors 10 each, Belial's unit 6, Hellblasters 5, Lion and Ballistus 4 each.
Lion's Will (1CP, either Command phase): +1 OC on a unit already on an objective. In Sacrifice, Victory (1CP): when a Deathwing unit dies on an objective, keep it secured.
Doctrine timing: you get Assault twice, then Devastator and Tactical once each. Save Assault for the rounds you charge onto the midfield.
Intercessors are your action-doers: Tactical Mainstay lets them act while engaged or battle-shocked and still shoot.
Save Insane Bravery (once per battle) for Azrael's unit or an Intercessor squad holding a key objective.

plan.note: Mission names from the disposition matrix; exact scoring is on your mission card. Share it for tailored tips.

rows.tip: Mirror: you both want objectives. Save Assault doctrine for the turn you charge onto theirs.
They want kills: Ezekiel and the Techmarine are easy ones; keep them in Rhinos or behind units.
They'll work in your territory: keep an Intercessor squad home; Tactical Mainstay lets it act while engaged.
They'll spread thin: Lancer (72") and Ballistus pick off lone scouts; Mist-wreathed sends the Lion after far ones.
They'll commit to key points: Belial's Teleport Homer drop or the Lion lands on whatever they commit.

items: Lion is Warlord; place the Teleport Homer; declare reserves; embark Rhinos
+1 CP from the Lion (Transhuman Strategist)
Pick a combat doctrine (Assault ×2, Devastator ×1, Tactical ×1 for the whole game)
Lion: pick 2 Primarch abilities; Master Strategist gives him a second doctrine
Strat: Lion's Will (+1 OC) or Tactical Mastery (Deathwing unit's own doctrine)
Azrael: name a unit within 9" and a doctrine (before that unit moves)
Techmarine: Blessing on a vehicle within 3" (heal D3, ignore modifiers)
Intercessors: +1 to hit if an objective is in range of them or the target
Strat: Relics of the Dark Age (+2 S) on Hellblasters
Start of their Shooting: Smokescreen on a Rhino (-1 CP) or the Lancer
End of their Movement (round 2+): Rapid Ingress + Teleport Homer for Belial's unit (0 CP)
Ezekiel targeted: Whispers of the Shadow Forest (-1 to hit him)

phases.name: Before the battle
items: Lion — must be your Warlord (Supreme Commander)
Belial + Knights — place one Teleport Homer token anywhere (once per battle)
Lion, Belial + Knights — may start in Deep Strike reserves

phases.name: Start of each battle round
items: Lion (Warlord) — Transhuman Strategist: gain 1 CP

phases.name: Command phase
items: Army — pick one combat doctrine for every unit: Assault (charge after Advancing), Devastator (ranged weapons get Assault), Tactical (shoot and charge after Falling Back)

Lion — pick 2 of: Mist-wreathed Shadow Realms (go to Strategic Reserves, ingress this turn's Movement, even round 1), Martial Exemplar (6" aura: melee re-roll hit and wound 1s), No Hiding From the Watchers (6" aura: FNP 5+ vs psychic and mortal wounds)
Lion — Master Strategist: one extra doctrine for him only, on top of the army's
Strat: Tactical Mastery (1CP) — a Deathwing unit gets its own doctrine until your next Command phase
Strat: Lion's Will (1CP, either turn) — unit in range of an objective gets +1 OC until end of turn
Strat: Insane Bravery (1CP) — auto-pass a Battle-shock test (once per battle)

phases.name: Movement phase
items: Azrael — Masterful Tactician: name one Adeptus Astartes unit within 9" he can see and a doctrine; it replaces that unit's doctrine until your next Command phase
Techmarine — start or end of his move: a vehicle within 3" heals D3 and can ignore hit/wound modifiers until your next Movement phase
Lion — ingress move if he used Mist-wreathed Shadow Realms
Reinforcements — Deep Strike >8" from enemies

phases.name: Shooting phase
items: Intercessors — Bolter Discipline: +1 to hit if an objective is in range of them or of the target
Ballistus — Sustained Hits 1 vs targets within 24"
Gladiator Lancer — vs Monsters/Vehicles: re-roll one hit, one wound and one damage roll
Ezekiel — Engulfing Fear (psychic level 1): roll D6 (1 = he's battle-shocked), then an enemy within 12" takes a Battle-shock test at -1
Rhinos — Firing Deck 2: two passengers shoot with the Rhino's storm bolter
Strat: Relics of the Dark Age (1CP) — an infantry unit's ranged attacks get +2 S
Strat: Explosives (1CP) — Explosives unit, enemy within 8": six D6, each 4+ = 1 mortal wound

phases.name: Charge phase
items: Assault doctrine — units that Advanced can still charge
Strat: Crushing Impact (1CP) — Lion, Ballistus or Lancer after a charge: roll D6 equal to its T, 5+ = MW to enemy (max 6), 1s hurt you

phases.name: Fight phase
items: Lion — always Fights First
Azrael's unit — +1 to hit vs Characters; Belial's unit — +1 to wound vs Characters
Strat: Gene-wrought Might (1CP) — melee gets Lance, plus +1 AP if the unit has Assault doctrine
Strat: Inescapable Justice (1CP) — melee gets Precision
Strat: Duty in Death (1CP, when enemy targets your unit) — dying models stay to fight on 4+ (+1 with Assault doctrine)
Belial — killed before his unit fights: 2+ and he still fights

phases.name: Opponent's turn (reactive)
items: Strat: Rapid Ingress (1CP; 0CP with Teleport Homer) — end of their Movement, not round 1; Belial's unit arrives within 3" of the token, >8" from enemies
Strat: Fire Overwatch (1CP) — end of their Movement: snap-shoot, hit on 6s
Strat: Smokescreen (1CP) — start of their Shooting: Rhino or Lancer gets cover; Rhinos -1 CP and ignore other uses
Strat: Armour of Contempt (1CP) — when an enemy shoots/fights your unit: its attacks get 1 worse AP
Ezekiel — Whispers of the Shadow Forest (psychic level 1): when targeted, D6 (1 = battle-shocked), attacks vs him -1 to hit this phase
Strat: Heroic Intervention (1CP) — end of their Charge: unit within 12" charges (Ballistus qualifies: Walker)
Strat: Counter-offensive (2CP) — their Fight phase: your unit fights next

phases.name: Always on
items: Dutiful Tenacity — attacks with Strength above your infantry's Toughness get -1 to wound
Azrael's unit — Stealth; melee attacks vs them -1 to hit; 4+ invulnerable
Deathwing Knights — every attack vs them has -1 Damage
Lion — -1 to wound if S beats T10; FNP 4+ vs psychic and mortal wounds; Lone Operative within 3" of DA infantry
Ezekiel — psyker level 3: psychic abilities used in a battle round add up to at most 3 levels
Damaged 4 (Ballistus, Lancer) — -1 to hit at 1-4 wounds left; the Techmarine's Blessing cancels it
One stratagem per unit per phase

Space Marine Chapters ARMY RULE
• When an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit's datasheet carries a second Faction keyword, that keyword names the unit's Chapter:
Marneus Calgar carries ADEPTUS ASTARTES and ULTRAMARINES, so he is an Ultramarine.
• An army may include units from one Chapter only.
Combat Doctrines ARMY RULE
Select one combat doctrine below at the start of your Command phase. The doctrine you pick stays active until your next
Command phase begins, for every friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit carrying this ability.
ASSAULT DOCTRINE
This unit stays eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance move.
DEVASTATOR DOCTRINE
This unitʼs ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
TACTICAL DOCTRINE
This unit stays eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it made a fall-back move.
Except where a rule says otherwise, each combat doctrine can be selected once per battle, and a unit can have only one
combat doctrine active at a time: a rule that makes a doctrine active for a unit ends whichever doctrine that unit had before.
Transhuman Strategist ARMY RULE
At the start of the battle round, gain 1CP if your WARLORD carries this ability.
Librarius ARMY RULE
A psyker level of 1 or higher is carried by every ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit with this ability, stated among that unit's
abilities, and a psychic level of 1 or higher belongs to each psychic ability, stated in its name.
Across one battle round, the psychic abilities a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit uses may add up to no more than
that PSYKER unit's own psyker level.
Example: a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit can spend a battle round on:
• Three abilities of psychic level 1.
• One of psychic level 1 with one of psychic level 2.
• A single ability of psychic level 3.
Dutiful Tenacity WRATH OF THE ROCK
Whenever an attack whose S beats the T of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit is aimed at it, that
attack takes -1 to its wound roll.
Assault Mastery ASSAULT BRETHREN
The assault doctrine can be selected one additional time per battle.
